fullPassage: Unfortunately, many people don't take personal responsibility for their own growth. Instead, they simply run the race laid out for them. They do well enough in school to keep advancing. Maybe they manage to get a good job at a well-run company. But so many think and act as if their learning journey ends with college. They have checked all the boxes in the life that was laid out for them and now lack a road map describing the right ways to move forward and continue to grow. In truth, that's when the journey really begins. When school is finished, your growth becomes voluntary. Like healthy eating habits or a regular exercise program, you need to commit to it and devote thought, time, and energy to it. Otherwise, it simply won't happen — and your life and career are likely to stop progressing as a result.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a duty to take care of something or deal with it"

det.korean: responsibility=책임 (무언가를 돌보거나 처리해야 할 의무)
det.analysis:
❌ ① journey(여정): 과정/여행으로 정의와 불일치
❌ ② growth(성장): 발전으로 '책임'의 정의와 다름
❌ ③ company(회사): 조직으로 정의와 다름
✅ ④ responsibility(책임): 무언가를 돌보거나 처리해야 할 의무라는 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: responsibility = 책임/책무 (a duty to take care of something)

questions.passage: Unfortunately, many people don't take __________ (person) responsibility for their own growth. Instead, they simply run the race laid out for them. They do well enough in school to keep advancing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 명사 person을 형용사 personal로 변환 (명사 responsibility 수식)
det.analysis: take와 명사 responsibility 사이에 명사를 수식하는 형용사가 필요하다. 명사 person(사람)을 형용사 personal(개인적인)로 바꿔 responsibility를 수식한다. person → personal
det.tip: person(명사) → personal(형용사, 개인적인). personal responsibility

questions.passage: They now lack a road map __________ (describe) the right ways to move forward and continue to grow. In truth, that's when the journey really begins. When school is finished, your growth becomes voluntary.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 동사 describe를 현재분사 describing으로 변환 (명사 road map 수식)
det.analysis: 명사 road map을 뒤에서 수식하는 분사가 필요하다. 로드맵이 '설명하는' 능동 관계이므로 현재분사 describing이 와야 한다. describe → describing (a road map (which is) describing ...)
det.tip: 명사 + 현재분사(describing): a road map describing ~ = ~을 설명하는 로드맵

questions.passage: Unfortunately, many people don't take personal responsibility for their own growth. Instead, they simply run the race laid out for them. They do well enough in school to keep advancing. Maybe they manage to get a good job at a well-run company. But so many think and act as if their learning journey __________. They have checked all the boxes in the life that was laid out for them and now lack a road map describing the right ways to move forward and continue to grow. In truth, that's when the journey really begins. When school is finished, your growth becomes voluntary. Like healthy eating habits or a regular exercise program, you need to commit to it and devote thought, time, and energy to it. Otherwise, it simply won't happen — and your life and career are likely to stop progressing as a result.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ends with college=대학에서 끝난다 — 많은 이들이 배움의 여정이 대학 졸업으로 끝난다고 (잘못) 여긴다는 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① ends with college(대학에서 끝난다): 많은 이들이 배움의 여정이 대학으로 끝난다고 여겨 이후 로드맵이 없게 된다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② starts in early childhood(어린 시절에 시작된다): 뒤의 '로드맵이 없다'는 문제와 연결되지 않음
❌ ③ never really matters at all(전혀 중요하지 않다): 본문과 무관
❌ ④ continues forever on its own(저절로 영원히 계속된다): 본문은 성장이 자발적 노력을 요한다고 함 — 반대
det.tip: as if their learning journey ends with college — 배움이 대학에서 끝난다고 여기다

Otherwise, it simply won't happen — and your life and career are likely to stop progressing as a result.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: when the journey really begins=여정이 진짜로 시작되는 때 — 학교가 끝날 때가 진짜 성장의 시작이라는 맥락
det.analysis:

✅ ② when the journey really begins(여정이 진짜로 시작되는 때): 학교가 끝날 때가 진짜 성장 여정의 시작이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ why schools exist at all(학교가 존재하는 이유): 본문과 무관
❌ ④ how big companies grow fast(큰 회사가 빨리 성장하는 법): 본문과 무관
